name: notion-search
description: Search across Notion workspace for pages and database rows matching a query. Returns a list of page references. Use when the user wants to find something they already wrote, not fetch a specific known page.

name: notion-fetch
description: Fetch the full content of a specific Notion page or database by its ID or URL. Returns page body, blocks, and properties. Use when the user references a specific Notion page they want to read.

name: notion-create-pages
description: Create one or more new pages in Notion under a given parent page or database. Use when the user wants to log, record, or save something new into Notion.

name: notion-update-page
description: Update properties or content of an existing Notion page. Use to edit a page the user already has, not to create a new one.

name: notion-duplicate-page
description: Duplicate an existing Notion page into the same or a different parent. Use when the user asks to copy a page or use one as a template.

name: notion-move-pages
description: Move Notion pages from one parent to another. Use when the user wants to reorganize their workspace.

name: notion-create-database
description: Create a new Notion database with specified schema. Use when the user wants to set up a new structured table, not to add a row to an existing one.

name: notion-update-data-source
description: Update a Notion database's schema (add/remove/rename properties). Use to change the structure of an existing database.

name: notion-create-view
description: Create a new view (table, board, calendar, gallery, timeline) of a Notion database. Use when the user wants a new lens on existing data.

name: notion-update-view
description: Update an existing Notion database view's filter, sort, or layout.

name: notion-create-comment
description: Add a comment to a Notion page or discussion. Use when the user wants to leave a note on a page, not edit its content.

name: notion-get-comments
description: Fetch comments attached to a specific Notion page.

name: notion-get-users
description: List Notion workspace members. Use when the user needs to reference or mention someone by their Notion user ID.

name: notion-get-teams
description: List teams inside the Notion workspace.

name: gmail-search-threads
description: Search Gmail for threads matching a Gmail query (from:, subject:, label:, etc.). Returns a list of thread IDs and snippets.

name: gmail-get-thread
description: Fetch the full content of a specific Gmail thread by ID, including all messages and headers.

name: gmail-create-draft
description: Create a Gmail draft email. Does not send. Use when the user wants to compose something they can review before sending.

name: gmail-list-drafts
description: List existing Gmail drafts in the user's mailbox.

name: gmail-list-labels
description: List all Gmail labels available in the mailbox.

name: gmail-create-label
description: Create a new Gmail label for organizing mail.

name: calendar-list-events
description: List events on the user's calendar for a given time range. Use when the user asks what's on their schedule.

name: calendar-get-event
description: Fetch a specific calendar event by ID. Use when the user references a known event they want details on.

name: calendar-create-event
description: Create a new calendar event. Use when the user wants to block time or schedule something.

name: calendar-update-event
description: Update an existing calendar event's time, attendees, or description.

name: calendar-delete-event
description: Delete a calendar event by ID.

name: calendar-respond-to-event
description: RSVP yes/no/maybe to a calendar invitation.

name: calendar-suggest-time
description: Propose meeting times that work across multiple attendees' calendars. Use for scheduling coordination.

name: calendar-list-calendars
description: List all calendars the user has access to (primary, shared, subscribed).

name: todoist-list-tasks
description: List Todoist tasks filtered by project, section, label, or IDs. Does not run complex query filters — use todoist-filter-tasks for that.

name: todoist-filter-tasks
description: Run a Todoist filter query like 'today | overdue' or '#Work & p1'. Use when the user asks for tasks matching a smart condition, not a simple list.

name: todoist-get-task
description: Fetch a single Todoist task by ID.

name: todoist-create-task
description: Create a new Todoist task with content, due date, priority, project, and labels.

name: todoist-update-task
description: Update fields on an existing Todoist task.

name: todoist-close-task
description: Mark a Todoist task as completed.

name: todoist-reopen-task
description: Reopen a previously completed Todoist task.

name: todoist-delete-task
description: Permanently delete a Todoist task. Use only when the user explicitly asks to delete, not complete.

name: todoist-list-projects
description: List all Todoist projects.

name: todoist-create-project
description: Create a new Todoist project.

name: todoist-list-comments
description: List comments on a Todoist task or project.

name: todoist-create-comment
description: Add a comment to a Todoist task or project.

name: slack-send-message
description: Post a message to a Slack channel or DM. Use when the user wants to send something in Slack.

name: slack-search-messages
description: Search Slack message history for text or from a specific user.

name: slack-list-channels
description: List Slack channels the user can access.

name: slack-read-channel
description: Read recent messages from a specific Slack channel.

name: linear-create-issue
description: Create a Linear issue in a given team with title, description, priority, and labels.

name: linear-update-issue
description: Update an existing Linear issue (status, assignee, priority).

name: linear-search-issues
description: Search Linear issues by title, description, assignee, or state.

name: linear-get-issue
description: Fetch a specific Linear issue by ID.

name: figma-get-design-context
description: Extract design context from a Figma file or frame — variables, components, layers, tokens. Use when the user wants to translate a Figma design into code.

name: figma-get-screenshot
description: Capture a PNG screenshot of a specific Figma frame or node.

name: figma-search-design-system
description: Search a Figma design-system library for components by name.

name: figma-get-variable-defs
description: Fetch variable definitions (colors, spacing, typography tokens) from a Figma file.

name: figma-create-design-system-rules
description: Generate design-system rules (CSS vars, config) from a Figma file.

name: whoop-get-profile
description: Fetch the user's Whoop profile (name, email, account id).

name: whoop-get-body-measurement
description: Fetch Whoop body measurements (height, weight, max heart rate).

name: whoop-list-cycles
description: List Whoop cycles (days) in a date range. Each cycle has strain, avg HR, kilojoules.

name: whoop-get-cycle
description: Fetch a specific Whoop cycle by ID.

name: whoop-list-recoveries
description: List Whoop daily recovery scores (0-100%) with HRV and resting HR.

name: whoop-get-cycle-recovery
description: Fetch the recovery score for a specific Whoop cycle.

name: whoop-list-sleep
description: List Whoop sleep sessions in a date range with stages, performance, and disturbances.

name: whoop-get-sleep
description: Fetch a specific Whoop sleep session by ID.

name: whoop-get-cycle-sleep
description: Fetch the sleep session associated with a specific Whoop cycle.

name: whoop-list-workouts
description: List Whoop workouts in a date range with strain, HR zones, and sport type.

name: whoop-get-workout
description: Fetch a specific Whoop workout by ID.

name: bluesky-create-post
description: Publish a post to Bluesky on the user's behalf.

name: bluesky-search-posts
description: Search Bluesky for posts matching a query or hashtag.

name: bluesky-get-profile
description: Fetch a Bluesky user profile by handle.

name: chrome-navigate
description: Navigate the user's Chrome browser to a given URL. Use for web app automation tasks where a dedicated MCP does not exist.

name: chrome-get-page-text
description: Extract the current Chrome page's visible text content.

name: chrome-form-input
description: Fill an input field on the current Chrome page.

name: chrome-javascript-eval
description: Evaluate arbitrary JavaScript in the current Chrome tab.

name: computer-screenshot
description: Capture a screenshot of the user's desktop. Use only when no dedicated or browser MCP fits, e.g. native desktop apps.

name: computer-left-click
description: Click a pixel coordinate on the user's desktop. Use only for native-app control when other tools are unavailable.

name: computer-type
description: Type text into the currently focused native app. Blocked on terminals and IDEs.

name: drive-search-files
description: Search Google Drive for files by name or content.

name: drive-read-file-content
description: Read the content of a Google Drive file (Docs, Sheets, PDFs).

name: drive-create-file
description: Create a new file in Google Drive.
